notes: One email, two Ervos: the same sign-in can have Ervo Personal and Ervo for Business, each with its own chats, Psyche, activity, settings and notifications. Switch between them in Settings
Real sign-in: Ervo now sends a 6-digit code to your email. Anyone who had a preview account signs in again once
Ervo for Business teams: pick Company or Employee when you sign up. Owners create employee IDs; employees join with the company name and their ID, and nobody else can
Owners get a Team tab: every employee, their office hours, and their chats with Ervo
Say "send this to Maria" or "tell Sam: the shipment is late" and Ervo delivers it inside their Ervo
Employees set office hours in Settings, and their Ervo keeps to work

The sky on Ervo Stats now matches the real weather: rain and drizzle bring gray clouds and slanted rain behind glass, storms flash with lightning, fog rolls in, snow falls, and the sun with its rays only shows when it's actually clear or partly cloudy
Clouds are already in the sky when you open Stats instead of drifting in from the side
Updates can't get stuck anymore: Android checks for a new Ervo a few times a day and shows a notification the moment one is out. Tap it and Ervo updates, even if the app itself won't open
If Ervo ever fails to start, a small dialog offers Update Ervo or Try Again
Fixes the black screen in 0.3.7: the app crashed while starting up
Ervo Stats is new: your usage today with what's left, milestones you've reached, what's coming up with a busy meter for the next 7 days, and your recent activity
